title: DiagnoseResult
description: What a diagnose Smith writes to /work/out/result.json (Propose a fix). The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result diagnose. summary has no maxLength here: the engine truncates it to 40 characters.

summary.description: The proposal, shown in the ticket view: 40 characters or fewer, or the engine truncates it.

content.description: Passed on to a brief or a GitHub comment, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
